metadata.title: Review, Verify, and Document
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Systematically review identified files for content relevant to the investigation scope, verify against criteria, identify issues, categorize them, and create comprehensive findings documentation.

prerequisites: Identified files list from previous step
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: read files → analyze content → verify against criteria → identify issues → categorize → document findings
Review files systematically - don't skip any identified files
For each file, extract all content relevant to investigation scope
Verify each relevant item against all applicable criteria
Document findings clearly with file paths and line numbers when applicable

read: memory.json (previous step section: identified files list, JSON file reference)

tools: read_file - Read memory.json, process.md, identified-files.json, each file for review
grep - Search for specific patterns or content in files
codebase_search - Understand context or find related content
bestPractices: Review files systematically - don't skip any identified files
For each file, extract all content relevant to investigation scope
Verify each relevant item against all applicable criteria
Document findings clearly with file paths and line numbers when applicable
Categorize issues consistently: Missing, Incorrect, Violation, Incomplete, Format Error, Other
Assign severity levels consistently: Critical, High, Medium, Low
Create structured data (JSON) for issues to enable programmatic processing
Log progress for large file sets (>50 files)
Save issues data to separate JSON file to keep memory.json clean

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Read Context Parameters and File List
substeps.description: Read investigation scope, verification criteria, and identified files list
actions: Read from memory.json previous step section: identified files list
Read from memory.json previous step section: investigationScope, verificationCriteria
Understand investigation scope: what content to look for in files
Understand verification criteria: what conditions must be met
Document context parameters in log.json

substeps.name: Initialize Tracking Structures
substeps.description: Create tracking structures for review progress and issue categorization
actions: Create tracking structure for review progress
Initialize issue categorization structure with categories: Missing, Incorrect, Violation, Incomplete, Format Error, Other
Initialize severity levels: Critical, High, Medium, Low
Initialize counters (files reviewed, items verified, issues found)

substeps.name: Review Each File Systematically
substeps.description: Review each identified file, verify content against criteria, identify issues
actions: For each file in the identified files list:
Log progress: 'Reviewing file X of Y: {file path}'
Read file content using read_file
Analyze file content for relevance to investigation scope
For each relevant item: document location, verify against criteria, create issue record if verification fails
Mark file as reviewed, increment counters
Log completion: 'Reviewed {count} files, verified {count} items, found {count} issues'

substeps.name: Categorize and Assign Severity to Issues
substeps.description: Categorize issues and assign severity levels
actions: For each issue, determine category and severity
Count issues by category and severity
Log categorization results

substeps.name: Create Findings Documentation
substeps.description: Create findings report and issues list files
actions: Create findings-report.md with: Executive Summary, Review Findings, Verification Results, Issues Found (if any)
If issues found, create issues-list.json with structured issue data
Record: summary
Record: actions taken

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Record processWideObservations.patternsDetected with any cross-file patterns found during review (e.g., repeated code structures, shared issues across files, common anti-patterns)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Read context and files → Initialize tracking → Review each file → Categorize issues → Create documentation → Update memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Previous step section (identified files list, investigationScope, verificationCriteria), process.md
fields: Information Produced: Findings report path, Issues list path, Files reviewed count, Items verified count, Issues found count, Counts by category/severity, Verification status
Decisions Made: Issue categorization scheme, Severity levels assigned, Verification approach
